svg.text: Choose the plot from the comparison the reader has to see.
Is the value higher in one group?
✗ avoid: bar + SEM when n is small
✗ avoid: mean ± SD alone for skewed data
✗ avoid: two y-axes on one plot
What is each group made of?
Which differ most, and by how much?
✗ avoid: Venn with more than 3 sets; rainbow scales
How does it change, and for whom?
✗ avoid: a mean line that hides the patients
✗ avoid: hairball networks with no question
